gaps.implementation_rule: new typed controlled errors wrap original errors + Canceled/Limit/OOM; legacy entry points run same internal engine with existing budget/no-cancel policy. Charge source operands, token comparisons and actual reserve capacity. No lower crate imports scene, all control lives in base. Controlled resumable progress is required for product incremental decoder, not alleged implemented here. Queue itself unchanged: owned job context contains source lease + bounded owned result slot/channel keyed id/generation, publishes Tile there and TaskOutput completion id only; rejected submit returns context, stale/canceled work drops tile. Sessions retain real parser/cascade/index loop cursors and flatten stacks, never fake progress or restart from source. Pending never exposes final success; finish fails unless complete. Existing one-shot methods drive same sessions to completion. CSS compute/gradient/reference lookup continuations inside Decoder must also retain real cursor state when quantum ends. Renderer row/group/filter continuations follow the same control contract; broad responsive product gate remains measured later.
